title: Chosen blocks lie in the remaining set
statement: For a finite set of elements, a finite subset called the remaining set, and natural numbers $d$ and $t$, consider a choice of $t$ pairwise disjoint blocks, each of size $d$, drawn successively from the elements still remaining. Every block in the resulting list is a subset of the original remaining set.
hypotheses_covered: A finite type of elements with decidable equality
A choice of t disjoint blocks of size d
A block belongs to the choice's block list
